suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as thromboembolic complication. Require documented isolated distal deep-vein thrombosis preceding separately documented symptomatic pulmonary embolism. PMID 42134598 specifically studied iDDVT and should not by itself be used to quantify or characterize PE risk across all proximal or other DVT phenotypes. Do not infer pulmonary embolism from DVT alone, and do not treat population-level complication rates as proof that an individual's PE arose from a particular DVT without appropriate clinical attribution. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) / Phlebitis and Pulmonary Embolism
